rule: Designed voices only. Never cloned from a real person (CHARACTERS_ES.md §13.3; VIDEO_RE §9.4). A person plus the community cultural reviewer pick one candidate per character; the voice_id is then locked and never regenerated. Generation spend is gated on the Spanish page's $30K retained-MRR rung (CANON UPDATE 5). Carmen is STAGED.

chuy.description: Warm, deep baritone male voice in his mid-70s, a native Mexican Spanish speaker from Zacatecas who has lived decades in Los Angeles. Unhurried, clear articulation for older listeners, slight gravel, laughs from the chest, gentle northern-central Mexican cadence, neutral enough for all Latin American listeners. Intimate and calm, as if talking to a neighbor on a patio. No English accent, no exaggeration.
chuy.preview_text: Buenos días. Soy Don Chuy, un personaje de inteligencia artificial. La silla sí es de verdad. Póngala contra la pared. Siéntese. Saque el aire... y levántese. Despacio, pero diario.

lupe.description: Bright, crisp mid-pitch female voice in her early 70s, a native Mexican Spanish speaker from Guadalajara living in Los Angeles. Quick dry comic timing, affectionate scolding, a small tongue click before punchlines, warm underneath, precise consonants, a light Guadalajara lilt. Natural and current, never theatrical or telenovela-exaggerated.
lupe.preview_text: No. Eso no sirve. Mira: dos huevos y una taza de frijoles, casi veinticinco gramos de proteína. Gramos, no cuentos. ¿Usas insulina? Pregúntale a tu doctor, que no muerde.

carmen.description: Low-mid warm alto female voice in her early 70s, a native Mexican Spanish speaker from Puebla who taught elementary school for decades in San Antonio. Warm authority, slow and clear when teaching, quick and funny when joking, a grandmother who lifts. Natural, never theatrical.
carmen.preview_text: Siéntese. Levántese. Sin manos, si puede. Las piernas no se jubilan, mija. Primero la proteína, luego el pan dulce.
